## Preset "Lang-Main"

- New cards per day: 15 (was 30 until Feb 2024, burned out hard, backlog hit 900)
- Maximum reviews per day: 250
- Learning steps: 1m 10m 1h
- Graduating interval: 3 days, easy interval 5 days
- Relearning steps: 10m
- Leech threshold: 8 lapses, action = tag only
- FSRS switched on since Anki 23.10, desired retention 0.88, optimised parameters monthly

## Add-ons

- Review Heatmap (1771074083), the green squares keep me honest
- AwesomeTTS for the German deck

## Sync

AnkiWeb account, AnkiDroid on my Pixel 7, desktop on the work MacBook. Sync conflict in January 2025 wiped a day of
reviews, now I always sync on close.

## Things I changed and why

Dropped retention from 0.92 to 0.88 in March 2025: daily load went from ~210 to ~140 reviews and true retention only
fell 2 points. Theory behind the numbers in [[Spaced repetition intervals]]; the March log is in
[[Learning journal March]].
